rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, interface guards, RegisterHandlerDirective and Caddyfile parsing all match siblings; handler config uses time.Duration rather than the caddy.Duration convention for JSON fields.
rationale.edge_cases: Hard cap, negative-disables, empty writes, deadline-unsupported (logged once), nil body handled; but nested server+route wrappers both call the same controller so the server default always overwrites per-route deadlines, and http.NoBody gets wrapped needlessly.
rationale.scope: Exactly the requested surface plus a reasonable Caddyfile adapt test; no unrelated refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear IdleDeadline.next with a good doc comment; Write/ReadFrom loops are straightforward; a few comments repeat the same slowloris paragraph.
rationale.robustness: No panics, deadline failures degrade gracefully, chunking bounds each underlying call; stale write deadline can persist across keep-alive requests when WriteTimeout is 0, and deadlines precede buffered rather than network writes.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline type reused by server and handler; minor duplication of started/deadlineNA bookkeeping between reader and writer.
